Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: one high-fidelity desktop web app screen for Reel Travel. Generate one single large straight-on flat desktop screenshot, landscape 16:10, crisp high resolution, finely rendered typography; no laptop frame, perspective, collage or multiple screens. Deliver a fully art-directed polished product concept with plenty of readable content and realistic spacing. Reel Travel turns travel links, text and screenshots into evidence-linked confirmed places and editable short-trip itineraries. All data shown are synthetic design examples. No factual claims about real venues, unsupported social import promises, fake ratings, statistics, collaborator avatars or chat assistant. Photographs may be decorative destination atmosphere only and explicitly illustrative; never pose as venue evidence. Maps are illustrative geometry. All screen text should be correctly spelled. Small quiet footer "DESIGN CONCEPT · SAMPLE DATA".
Visual direction: Editorial Blue. Warm editorial travel journal. Background #f7f6f3, white cards, ink #1c1917, royal blue #1d4ed8 actions. Fine warm-gray borders, 12px corners, airy 24px spacing. System-like clean sans serif for controls and workflow titles, beautiful Georgia-like serif for hero/trip titles only. Atmospheric destination cover photography used sparingly. Horizontal day selectors and slim vertical trip navigation. Refined practical approachable.
Screen brief: Public marketing home page. Top wordmark "Reel Travel", links "How it works", "Sample trip", "Sign in", primary "Start a trip". Strong hero exact headline "Your saved places. A trip that works." Supporting copy "Turn travel links, notes and screenshots into places you confirm and days you can edit." Primary "Start a trip", secondary "Explore a sample trip". A large sophisticated editorial destination scene of Tokyo beside or behind a framed, legible mini itinerary preview marked "Sample trip", "Partially checked", "Sample dinner · Fixed booking". Below a concise three-step row "Save inspiration", "Confirm places", "Shape your days" and supporting product preview strip. Small clear caption "Illustrative imagery". Footer "Design concept". No fake testimonials, logos, statistics, subscriptions, prices or guarantee that every social link can be imported. Focus on a beautiful complete desktop landing viewport, generous type scale and composition.
